round2_dispositions.evidence: Dedicated Granola group draws the key field and Connect directly (gm-empty.png).
Footer sentence is the group footer.
Live questions group removed from the mobile frame.
Synced row has a spinner while syncing (gm-syncing.png).
After "Synced 42 meetings" nothing on the phone points to the Granola agent; the plan keeps the agent link web-only for the first release (granola.md Surfaces).
Disconnect is still a red row that acts at once. The plan decides "no confirmation dialog" because meetings are kept; flagged only as an iOS-convention deviation to verify on device.
Back control is now 44 pt and the Connecting button now has a spinner (fixed). The status bar is still three dots instead of signal, Wi-Fi and battery glyphs (frame chrome only).

new_findings.description: The empty Granola key field has no placeholder and no field chrome. On the phone it is a 13 pt stacked caption "Granola API key · Business plan" over blank space (59 pt row empty, 60 pt row in Reconnect needed), so it reads as a section caption rather than an input. iOS forms show a placeholder or an inline label with a trailing value.
new_findings.expected: A user can tell at a glance that the row takes a pasted key.
new_findings.actual: Empty state and Reconnect needed show a label and an empty dark row; only the Connect button below hints that something is to be entered.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Draw the label inline at the left with a muted placeholder such as "Paste key" at the right (iOS LabeledContent/SecureField), or add a placeholder. The plan removed web placeholders; the phone needs its own decision.

new_findings.description: In the Disconnected state, "Rakazo keeps your meetings and to-dos." is a bare caption between the "Granola" header and the key group. The plan says it is a plain first row of the group.
new_findings.expected: A first row inside the group.
new_findings.actual: Floating caption under the header, 0 padding above the field group (gm-disconnected.png).
new_findings.suggested_fix: Draw it as the first plain row of the group, or as a group footer.
